content: Scopus/Elsevier SDG mapping is produced via a search-query + ML/TF-IDF matching process over Title/Abstract/Author-Keywords/Indexed-Terms/Subject-Areas, published as periodic dataset releases (e.g. 2023, 2025 mapping versions) rather than a single stable documented API field; there is no confirmed public API field name returning a raw 0.0-1.0 relevance weight per SDG per publication in general documentation, meaning the project's assumption of a directly queryable weight field needs verification against the actual Scopus API response the team has access to.
